visibleFindings: A dark navy flow canvas occupies roughly the top 300px of the image (x≈24–588) with a faint dot-grid texture, small node cards, and thin gray connector lines between them.

About eleven card shapes are discernible; each is a small dark-navy rectangle (~51–54px wide, ~33–69px tall) with rounded corners and a short colored label at its top (teal, violet, amber, pink/red, indigo, or bright green), with the label wording too small to read.

Two identically sized cards (~52×69px) are stacked on the right side (x≈419 at y≈73 and y≈157) with indigo top labels; each contains, top to bottom: a tiny gray label row, a full-width darker strip resembling a select, another tiny label row, a taller darker block resembling a notes textarea, a row with a ~3px square plus text, and two ~2.6px port dots near the bottom-left.

The rightmost card (x≈485–537, y≈112–177) has a bright green/teal label and contains a label row, three rows each with a ~3px square checkbox plus text, a fourth row in noticeably brighter text than the others, a fifth square-plus-text row, and three ~2.6px port dots centered along the card bottom.

Two similar cards (≈291,69 and ≈326,159) each show a select-like strip, a small square-plus-text row, a tiny help row, and a row of seven tiny port dots along the bottom edge; the card at ≈291,69 is outlined with a bright teal border unlike any other card.
One card at top-center (≈291,-3) is clipped by the canvas top edge; the remaining cards appear fully inside the canvas.
Connector lines are thin and low-contrast gray; several converge on the small port dots and some pass beneath card bodies.

All in-card text (labels, option text, checkbox captions, note areas) renders at roughly 3–5px and is illegible; the individual controls are distinguishable mainly by shape and their darker-navy fill against the slightly lighter card body.
A small teal pill/badge with illegible text sits in the canvas lower-right (≈x535–590, y≈283–298).

Below the canvas is a slightly lighter navy rounded panel (x≈24–588, y≈314–504) whose hint line is legible: 'Pan: drag · Zoom: wheel · Drag cards by their teal header · Flow: brief → prompts → drafts → finishing → review → checklist → export'.
Centered in that panel are the legible labels 'Nodes in graph' over a large bold '14', and 'Typed links' over a large bold '20', in light text.
A strip of darker page background with no visible content runs along the bottom of the image (≈y504–528).
uncertainty: The two indigo-labeled right-side cards are probably the 'review' cards and the green-labeled card the 'checklist' card, based on the panel's flow description, but the actual card titles are unreadable in the image.
The bright teal border on the card at ≈291,69 may indicate selection or highlight, but selection state cannot be confirmed from a static image.
The brighter fourth row in the green-labeled card may be an emphasized 'ready'-style control, but its label and state are unreadable.

The dark strips and blocks resembling a status select and a notes textarea may be interactive inputs, but a static image cannot establish whether they are functional form controls or miniature representations.
The tiny teal pill in the canvas lower-right could be a zoom control, counter, or badge; its text is illegible so its purpose is unclear.

The illegibility of card text suggests the canvas is zoomed out and the cards are scaled-down renderings of larger forms, but the actual rendered text size/content cannot be confirmed from the image alone.
notEstablished: The readable wording of any card title, field label, select option, checkbox caption, or notes placeholder — none is legible at this zoom.
That the indigo-labeled cards are titled 'Review & approval' or that the green-labeled card is titled 'Merge & delivery checklist' — the focus terms are not verifiable in the image.
The current values or selected state of the select-like strips and the contents of the textarea-like blocks on any card.
Any header, title, or subtitle content above the canvas — the top of the page is outside the imaged area and no such text is discernible.
Interaction behavior (panning, zooming, dragging cards, editing fields) — the panel hint describes controls, but the image does not establish behavior.
Whether the graph is complete — the panel reports 14 nodes while roughly 11 cards are visible, so cards may exist outside the current view.
A footer: no footer is discernible in the imaged area, so its existence is not established.

fingerprintMeaning: Source and preview state identity, not a pixel digest. Separate successful observations may have different fingerprints and identical pixels.
limitation: Host validation establishes capture identity and freshness, not the truth of modelAssessment. Every category, including visibleFindings, is model-declared and may contain unsupported claims. Focus wording does not establish element existence. Only the captured frame region/state was supplied; source relationships, unseen content and interaction outcomes require separate checks. Equal image bytes across separate observations do not prove stale capture or a rasterizer defect. Owned overlays within the frame may be included; outside portals refuse capture and Studio chrome is excluded. Overlay counts are hints, not an exhaustive inventory.

retainedKnowledge.scope: Complete contract bodies delivered in this turn only; reuse still requires their content to remain available in model context. Source facts are never cached knowledge.

visualEvidence.scope: Captured regions only; source freshness does not establish current runtime/viewport freshness or offscreen/interaction coverage.

turnProgress.evidence: Host receipt-derived totals include all acknowledged transactions, including cleanup. Outside-tool time is waiting/generation/transport/host overhead, not measured provider latency. Captured regions do not establish full-page or interaction coverage.
